title: Bihar ITI CAT Offline Mop-Up Counselling 2025
organization: Bihar Combined Entrance Competitive Examination Board
postName: ITICAT Offline Mop-Up Counselling for vacant ITI seats
vacancyDetails: Offline mop-up round for leftover ITI seats after online allotment rounds
qualification: Matric / ITICAT eligibility + rank; willingness for mop-up as per notice
selectionProcess: Online rounds → Willingness for mop-up → Offline counselling → Admission
documentsRequired: Photo, signature, educational certificates, photo ID, category certificate if applicable
howToApply:
1. Visit https://bceceboard.bihar.gov.in ITICAT section
2. Read offline mop-up counselling notice and seat matrix
3. Submit willingness if required online
4. Appear at counselling venue with originals
5. Complete admission at allotted ITI
shortDescription: Bihar ITI CAT Offline Mop-Up Counselling – final chance for vacant ITI seats. Check schedule on bceceboard.bihar.gov.in.
content:
BCECEB conducts offline mop-up counselling for ITICAT after online seat allotment rounds to fill remaining ITI seats.

Eligible candidates should download the mop-up seat matrix and schedule from bceceboard.bihar.gov.in, submit willingness if notified, and attend offline counselling with original documents.
